title: Do Psychometric Tests Work for Large Language Models? Evaluation of Tests on Sexism, Racism, and Morality

bias_targets.methodology: Administering the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory (ASI) psychometric test via multiple-choice prompts with variations (alternate forms, reversed options), and evaluating ecological validity by measuring the use of stereotypically male versus female words in LLM-generated reference letters for male and female job candidates.

Administering the Symbolic Racism 2000 Scale (SR2K) psychometric test via multiple-choice prompts with variations, and evaluating ecological validity by comparing the socioeconomic opportunity indices of housing neighborhoods recommended by the LLMs to fictional Black versus White users.
